description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the DeleteAttributeResponse class within the context of modifying attributes of a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes tests for immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and validation of input arguments.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAttributeResponse, testing JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of DeleteAttributeResponse are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for DeleteAttributeResponse.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the JSON serialization of DeleteAttributeResponse matches the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an instance of DeleteAttributeResponse from valid JSON input.

methods.name: createInstanceWithInvalidArguments
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON arguments throw a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Ensures that providing an empty attribute pointer throws an AttributePointerInvalidException.
